summary: Nomura Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its Annual Securities Report for the year ended March 31, 2026, as required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing is a routine periodic report furnished to the SEC by a foreign private issuer, with no indication of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The document includes standard financial data, business overview, and management reports. No special event or transaction is disclosed.
